# ex: needParen adds parens when binary expr replaces X in index, slice, call, and type assert
ex {
	var x int
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f(x int) []int { return nil }

func h(a int) {
	// IndexExpr: f(a)[0] -> (a+1)[0]
	_ = f(a)[0]
	// SliceExpr: f(a)[0:1] -> (a+1)[0:1]
	_ = f(a)[0:1]
}
